principal_fields: collection_id, OMB_control, component, title, authority, approval_lineage
constraints: Identity binds every table and narrative output.

principal_fields: scenario_id, collection_id, baseline_id, policy_date, price_year, first_year, horizon, status
constraints: Approved, proposed and notice versions remain separate.

principal_fields: source_id, author, title, publication_date, reference_period, URL, retrieval_date, hash, access_status
constraints: Citation-ready metadata; publication date differs from data reference period.

principal_fields: locator_id, source_id, page, table, row, cell, quoted_value, extraction_method
constraints: A transformed input links to the original observation and its locator.

principal_fields: population_id, unit_type, count, period, query_filters, source_id, coverage, exclusions
constraints: Persons, firms, establishments, sites, assets and events are distinct types.

principal_fields: segment_id, parent_population_id, eligibility_rule, share/count, overlap_type
constraints: Exclusive partitions sum to one; overlapping groups require an explicit union.

principal_fields: obligation_id, legal_citation, activity_id, owning_control, exclusion/transfer_reason
constraints: Cross-control movements have source and destination entries.

principal_fields: activity_id, segment_id, task, trigger, mode, role_id, one_time_or_recurring
constraints: Atomically priced work; a purchased activity is not also charged as internal time.

principal_fields: frequency_id, activity_id, events_per_period, periods_per_year, eligibility_share
constraints: Annualize rates only after reconciling periods and denominators.

principal_fields: time_id, activity_id, value, time_unit, statistic, scope, assumption_id
constraints: Mean, median, percentile and elapsed/active time cannot be interchanged.

principal_fields: role_id, task_description, SOC, NAICS, locality, selection_reason
constraints: Industry employment weights are not automatically task labor shares.

principal_fields: wage_id, role_id, source_id, year, wage_statistic, base_rate, units
constraints: Preserve suppressed values and historical code changes.

principal_fields: compensation_id, wage_id, method_enum, benefit_value/share, denominator, reference_period
constraints: Direct compensation, wage markup and wage/compensation-share use different equations.

principal_fields: overhead_id, components, direct_cost_exclusions, industry_matrix, occupation_weights, annual_hours
constraints: Monetary units, average/marginal interpretation and potential double counting are explicit.

principal_fields: transform_id, input_id, index_series, base_period, target_period, ratio, rationale
constraints: Detect overlapping nominal updates; distinguish wage from output-price inflation.

principal_fields: service_id, activity_id, quantity, unit_price, price_scope, vendor_evidence, payer
constraints: Outside professional hours are a service quantity, not necessarily Item12 respondent hours.

principal_fields: asset_id, cohort_year, quantity, price, useful_life, replacement_rule, residual_value, annualization_method, discount_rate
constraints: Asset life, approval horizon and annual purchase flow are separate.

principal_fields: federal_activity_id, workload, time, grade/role, locality, benefits_method
constraints: Include only attributable resource use; explain zero or allocation.

principal_fields: allocation_id, contract/system/budget_line, gross_cost, allocation_driver, fraction, fee_offset
constraints: Gross cost and net budget effect remain separate outputs.

principal_fields: assumption_id, estimate_method, evidence_ids, justification, applicability, uncertainty, review_date
constraints: Unsupported does not mean zero; analyst judgment is identifiable.

principal_fields: model_id, version, equation/algorithm, coefficients, calibration_population, training_period, legal_cutoff, diagnostics, access_status
constraints: Can generate time and purchases jointly; restricted data limit public replication.

principal_fields: observation_id, target_input, method, sample_size, sample_frame, segment, task_scope, statistic, distribution
constraints: Distinguish empirical plausibility from spreadsheet arithmetic.

principal_fields: formula_id, expression_tree, input_ids, output_unit, rounding_rule, source_formula, observed_cache
constraints: Acyclic dependencies; deterministic evaluation; independent result versus cached value.

principal_fields: change_id, baseline_id, proposed_id, changed_input/obligation, reason, analytical_type, ROCIS_type, delta_by_metric
constraints: Old + program changes + adjustments = new, separately for responses, hours and nonlabor dollars.

principal_fields: decomposition_id, changed_inputs, update_order, interaction_term, counterfactual_values
constraints: Driver effects depend on order; store the convention rather than hiding interactions.

principal_fields: check_id, formula/model_version, expected, actual, tolerance, status, severity, disposition
constraints: A known source defect is distinct from an extraction defect.

principal_fields: output_id, semantic_item, table_cell/sentence, formula_ids, source_ids, scenario_id
constraints: Prose cannot invent numbers or inherit values from a different scenario.
